thread:
maya: Customer reports they can't start free trial because we're forcing card-on-file + 3DS keeps failing. Customer id: acct_9X7bDf, email: dev+acme@acme.io. Flow gets stuck on the 3DS challenge — they see a blank iframe or 'challenge timed out'. Promo code 'ACME50' won't apply since checkout errors out. Can billing ops grant trial credits while we investigate?

liam: @maya can you paste the payment intent id or a screenshot of the failed error? quick check: is this only on mobile / Safari?

maya: PaymentIntent: pi_1Kq7Tz2eZvKYlo2C0xYwXrQ. Customer on iPhone Safari, iOS 16.4. Error shown in console: "authentication_required" / "3ds_challenge_failed". They tried twice. No redirect to bank page.

chargebot: webhook: payment_intent.succeeded not fired; payment_intent.requires_action -> last_charge.status: failed -> failure_code: authentication_flow_failed

sophie: Two quick possibilities: 1) Safari ITP blocking third-party cookies causing the 3DS iframe to be blank. 2) Our client may be using the wrong Stripe confirm method (should use "redirect_to_url" for iOS webviews or SCA redirect flow). Also check if the PaymentIntent was created with payment_method_options[card][request_three_d_secure] = "any" — banks may start a challenge but then reject due to mismatch.

alex: Can we reproduce? maya, drop the full request payload (sanitized) and the response from our API (no PII). If we can reproduce on an iPhone simulator we can escalate to payments infra. Also adding a verbose log collector helps: run `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug ./bin/checkout --simulate 3ds` and attach results.

maya: payload (sanitized):
```
{ "customer": "acct_9X7bDf", "amount": 0, "promo": "ACME50", "require_card": true, "return_url": "https://console.redwood.com/onboard/finish" }
```
response snippet:
```
{ "status": "requires_action", "next_action": { "type": "use_stripe_sdk" } }
```
Customer says the Stripe modal never appears.

liam: OK. Billing ops can manually apply a trial credit. I'll do a 30-day trial grant and a $0 invoice for now. Ticket for ops: OPS-3421. maya, confirm customer id and I'll apply.

maya: Confirmed acct_9X7bDf. Please set note: "3DS challenge loop on iOS Safari; customer couldn't complete card auth; trial granted pending fix" :thumbsup:

sophie: I'll open an infra ticket. Probable fix: update client to use `stripe.redirectToCheckout` with `mobile: { useRedirect: true }` (workaround) or switch to PaymentRequest/3DS redirect for Safari. Also adding fallback to email verification for promo-only trials (temporary).

alex: I'll check our 3DS frame headers — some banks block when we set X-Frame-Options. If that's the case we need to proxy or change CSP. Repro plan: reproduce on iOS Safari + Charles proxy to see if iframe is blocked.

liam: Done — trial credited, OPS-3421 updated with notes, invoice status: credit_applied. Maya, please confirm with customer and paste confirmation here so I can close.

maya: Will do. I'll ask them to retry with Chrome on mobile or desktop as a workaround. If they can't, they have the trial now. I'll follow up with logs and attach the iOS repro trace when available.

sophie: Filing infra ticket: PAY-789 to investigate 3DS iframe blank on Safari + identify if CSP or cookie blocking is root cause.

maya: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until PAY-789 closes. :eyes:
